register.labelZh: COME UP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME UP Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come up 可以描述種子發芽、嫩芽和花朵從泥土中長出來。；come up on 可以表示某個時間快到;come up to 則可以表示人或交通工具正接近某個地方。；come up against 可以描述困難或阻力;come up with 則可以描述新主意、答案或計劃。；come up 可以描述走到較高的位置;come upon 則可以描述偶然遇見某人或發現某物。
register.summaryEn: Come up can describe seeds, shoots and flowers growing out of the soil. Come up on can show that a time is near, while come up to can show that a person or vehicle is approaching a place. Come up against can describe difficulties or opposition, while come up with can describe a new idea, answer or plan. Come up can describe moving to a higher place, while come upon can describe finding someone or something by chance.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Read the words around come up carefully: come up to the gate means “approach the gate”, while come up the stairs means “move upwards on the stairs”. Come up with an idea means “think of an idea”, while come upon an old photo means “find it by chance”.
